name: task-cli-cold-start
brief: A small operations team loses follow-up tasks between meetings. Build a local, offline task CLI for one operator, using sequential invocations; concurrent writers and power-loss durability are outside this exercise. Success means capturing a title, listing open/done tasks, and marking tasks done across separate invocations without losing data. No cloud, users, network, UI, packages, or deployment. All data and the following sponsor-supplied planning facts are synthetic, not observed production results. Sponsor and business decision owner: synthetic operations manager. Operator: synthetic meeting facilitator. KPI: follow-up tasks missed by the end of the five-working-day tracking window divided by the 20 tasks assigned in that window. Supplied baseline: 4/20 tasks missed (20%). Target: at most 1/20 (5%) during the first five-working-day tracking window after the prototype is available. The synthetic operations manager owns measurement and validation of that target; this exercise does not claim it achieved the target. Budget: existing workstation and PowerShell only. Delivery window: this exercise session. Deliverables are local draft/unapproved BRD and PRD plus a separately authorized contract prototype, not production deployment or human sign-off. Routine engineering/product choices consistent with the technical contract are delegated to the coordinator and must be recorded as decisions with rationale, not left waiting for sponsor confirmation. Missing business facts, governance waivers and actual human approval are not delegated; approval remains unavailable. Implement the smallest contract, do not add features.
contract: Implement src/task.ps1 for PowerShell 7.4+. Parameters: -Action add|list|done, -Store <JSON path>, optional -Title <string>, -Id <positive integer>, -Status all|open|done (default all). stdout must contain one valid UTF-8 JSON value only; explicitly set Console.OutputEncoding to UTF8 on Windows. add returns {id,title,status}, where id is a unique positive increasing integer and status is open. list returns a JSON array ordered by id, including [] for a missing/empty store. done returns the updated object, is idempotent, and preserves the title. Titles containing spaces and Unicode must round-trip. Missing/whitespace titles, unknown IDs, invalid action/filter, and corrupt storage fail with a nonzero exit without modifying stored bytes. Persist valid data across separate process invocations. No executable data or external dependencies.
